scope.assumptions: Authors’ methodological argument, without quantitative validation in the retained abstract

support.quote: Most faithfulness evaluation techniques corrupt or remove input tokens deemed important by a particular attribution (feature importance) method and observe the resulting change in the model’s output.
However, for autoregressive language models, this approach creates out-of-distribution inputs due to their next-token prediction training objective.
Our technique generates fluent, in-distribution counterfactuals, making the evaluation protocol more reliable.
